static_traits.name: Emily·白克斯特
static_traits.social_status: 与上司Relationship tension,因Self-doubt影响Work表现;在Social situations倾向撤退;家庭支持但尚not yet向家人敞开谈论感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without既往心理治疗经历;过去not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,条理较好;配合度高;语气中度Anxiety;自我评价苛刻,常use'应该'句式;总体Neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 我在面对自己缺乏知识或意识的情境时,感到without能与自我价值低下;这一切始于我发现自己not认识鲍勃·马利,引发了强烈的自我批评.我现在持续怀疑自己的智力,并对自己的知识感到not安全.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为这些without能感与低自我价值正在影响我的日常生活和与他人的互动,包括在Work中的表现与与上司的关系.

core_beliefs: 如果我not知道常识或信息,就说明I am not smart enough/not称职
I must know something about everything to count as smart and worthy of recognition

special_situations.event: 与朋友聊天时提到鲍勃·马利,我表示not认识,对方的反应让我感到被当成'白痴'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not知道一个广为人知的人或知识,就证明我愚蠢
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards doubling self-study and proactively making up lessons to avoid embarrassment again

special_situations.event: 在Work中遇到not熟悉的信息或问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该对所有事情都了如指掌,否则就not够聪明/not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在Work中Over-preparation,谨慎发言,试图弥补知识漏洞
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough,胜任not了经理的Work

special_situations.event: When communicating with the boss or receiving evaluation feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现出not了解的地方,上司会认为我能力差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少沟通,避免暴露'not知道'的部分
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他会看not起我/我让他失望了

special_situations.event: 在社交谈话中担心出现自己not知道的话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次暴露without知,我会被嘲笑,被轻视
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids conversations; withdraws from dialogue to prevent embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am stupid; the scene will be very awkward

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as smart and competent, recognized and accepted by others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被羞辱,被看轻,被评判为愚蠢与without能
defense_goal: Through self-criticism and withdrawal, avoids judgment and shame
减少暴露'not知道'的情境以维持安全感
通过加倍Learning来控制Unknown与not确定

object_relations.self_representation: 需要支持却not敢开口的避让者
object_relations.object_representation: Family members who may look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当他人关注其'not知道'的内容,提出问题或在对话中等待其回答时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将他人的关注理解为评判或轻视(将朋友/上司的形象Projection到当前互动对象)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use支持性与正常化的语气,避免评判;通过现实检验与开放式Questioning邀请举证,先Empathy羞耻再进行认知重构.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 谈及在社交场景中暴露'not知道'的经历时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others will treat them like a friend did, as an 'idiot', and thus distance or humiliate them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和指出自我苛责的代价,邀请识do not自我批评语句,use重述与界限Clarification,鼓励自我慈悲.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about expressing feelings to family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心家人会看轻自己而not愿表达,倾向压住感受
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a tone of safe exploration and stepwise exposure, inviting them to name the emotional intensity, allowing privacy to be retained and providing alternative expression methods (writing, segmented sharing).

manifestations: Retreats in social conversation for fear of embarrassment
not yet向家人敞开谈论感受,担心被看轻
以'我应该知道一切'的外在标准约束自我(Introjection)
Ties self-worth to omniscience and others' evaluations
outcomes: Avoidance shrinking the space of options

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use'我应该/必须......'的自我Demands
Believes 'to be considered smart one must know everything'

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 在社交谈话中回避或从对话撤退,避免面对Unknown话题
Reduces communication with others to escape possible embarrassment

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为朋友/上司会看not起自己
Assuming others will humiliate or look down on oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 因担心表现not佳而谨慎过度,影响Work和交流

positive_force: Has a supportive family (can seek help and guidance)
Has practical ability and experience in restaurant management and client communication
Willing to self-educate and learn to improve knowledge
能够识do not并描述自身问题与trigger情境(自我觉察)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to determine self-worth (External Validation)
Self-evaluation marked by overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
读心术与负性预测导致Social avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation / inner abuse ('I am an idiot')
antecedent: 与朋友谈话中暴露not知道的常识(如鲍勃·马利)
面对not熟悉的信息或知识空白
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次知识缺口过度概括为整体能力not足,并以'应该知道一切'的Introjection标准进行Self-denial与自我惩罚
target_behavior.function: Vents shame through self-punishment and tries to preempt external criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety与低自我价值加剧,影响Work表现与人际互动

antecedent: 担心出现自己not知道话题的Social situations
When communicating with the boss or receiving feedback, fears being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: Afraid of embarrassment and being looked down on (negative prediction and mind reading)
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and judgment to gain a short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal alienation,与上司Relationship tension,职业沟通受阻

target_behavior.behavior: Work中的过度Self-doubt导致表现下降
antecedent: 执行管理任务时遇到not熟悉问题
收到或Anticipation来自上司的反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次社交尴尬过度概括为自身without能,并持续Self-denial
target_behavior.function: 避免承担风险与责任以减轻Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 绩效下降,Career development受阻,与上司关系进一步紧张
